rationale: Plan groups claims by provider specialty to compare volume, spend totals, means, and denial rates. Uses adjudicated_claims denominator (per T2 feedback) and min_group_size=30 to flag unstable small groups. Provider ranking sorts by paid_amount_sum to identify top 10 spenders. Report includes caveats established by prior feedback: synthetic_data (T1, T7, T9), small_groups (T4, justified by min_group_size=30), and association_not_causation (T3, for group comparisons). show_denominators=true ensures rates display numerator/denominator (T9 feedback).
